display.purpose: Screen titles, hero callouts, app wordmark. Always uppercase, Lexend 900.

title.purpose: Section headers within screens. Lexend 700 uppercase.

body.purpose: Exercise names, descriptions, observations. Inter 400. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: Form field labels, data categories. Inter 700 uppercase tracking-widest 0.625rem.

mono.purpose: Weights (kg), pace (min/km), connection status, TAF scores, timestamps. JetBrains Mono.

shadows.name: card-structural
shadows.purpose: Cards and elevated containers. Structural anchor, not decoration.

shadows.name: dropdown-ambient
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and overlays. Separates from background without drama.

shadows.name: voltage-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs and active nav icons. The only expressive light in the system.

shadows.name: fab-voltage
shadows.purpose: FAB (new workout button). Connects the button to the system accent.

shadows.name: nav-hud-glow
shadows.purpose: HUD sliding indicator on mobile nav. Persistent glow on active tab position.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for screen transitions, HUD indicator, overlay entrances.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: List item animations, stagger entrances, micro-interactions.

motion.name: forge-pop
motion.purpose: scale(0.65) opacity(0) → scale(1.1) → scale(1). Entry pop for key elements.

motion.name: hud-slide
motion.purpose: HUD indicator translation between nav tabs.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop nav visible; bottom mobile nav hidden.

extensions.northStar: O Caderno de Campo do Guerreiro
extensions.northStarDescription: Registro de batalha. Cada entrada conta. Peso e repetição como coordenadas de evolução. A interface é um instrumento, não uma vitrine.

rules.name: A Regra do Voltage
rules.text: O acento #CCFF00 aparece em ≤10% de qualquer tela. Não faz gradiente, não colore backgrounds decorativos, não aparece em texto de conteúdo. Cada aparição é uma declaração.

rules.name: A Regra Flat-by-Default
rules.text: Superfícies são flat em repouso. Sombras aparecem apenas como resposta a estado ou ancoragem estrutural. Glassmorphism nunca.

rules.name: A Regra do Uppercase
rules.text: Labels de dados, títulos de seção e botões: sempre uppercase via Lexend. Conteúdo (nomes, observações): title-case via Inter. Nunca o mesmo papel com as duas fontes.

rules.name: A Regra do Modo Claro
rules.text: Em light mode, surfaces viram cinza (#f5f5f5/#ffffff/#ebebeb). O Voltage permanece idêntico. Nenhum acento alternativo para modo claro.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ação primária. Voltage bg, texto preto, Lexend bold uppercase. Resposta tátil imediata.
components.css: .btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #CCFF00; color: #000; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.025em; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); filter: brightness(0.9); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ação secundária. Transparente, borda Forge Border, mesmo tipo do primary.
components.css: .btn-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #D1D5DB; font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.025em; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #333; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Container de dados de treino ou seção do dashboard. Forge Surface, borda Outline, rounded-xl.
components.css: .card { background: #111111; border: 1px solid #222222; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .section-title { font-family: 'Lexend', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 0.625rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Campo de texto. Forge Surface Raised, Forge Border, focus → Voltage borda + glow.
components.css: .input-label { display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #6B7280; margin-bottom: 6px; } .form-input { width: 100%; background: #1A1A1A; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 1rem; color: #fff; transition: border-color 0.15s; outline: none; } .form-input::placeholder { color: #4B5563; } .form-input:focus { border-color: #CCFF00; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(93% 0.28 126 / 0.18), 0 0 14px 0 oklch(93% 0.28 126 / 0.07); }

components.name: Mobile Nav Item
components.description: Tab da bottom nav mobile. Ativo: Voltage + scale-110 + glow. Inativo: Muted Text.
components.css: .nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 1; min-height: 52px; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 0; color: #6B7280; transition: color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; background: none; border: none; } .nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.9); } .nav-item--active { color: #CCFF00; } .nav-item--active svg { transform: scale(1.1); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px oklch(93% 0.28 126 / 0.9)); } .nav-item span { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.5625rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
